## Verification

## Review checklist

- [ ] Calendar data remains local and read-only.
- [ ] New or changed behavior has focused tests.
- [ ] German and English strings stay in sync, where applicable.
- [ ] Keyboard and VoiceOver behavior were checked for UI changes.
- [ ] Screenshots and logs contain only synthetic or redacted data.
